title: Structure Beats Willpower
hook: If you need willpower to do it every single day, the setup is the problem, not you.
statement: The right structure makes discipline mostly unnecessary.
explainer: Willpower runs out by Wednesday. A good setup doesn't. Make the right thing the easy thing and you stop having to fight yourself.
sop: Pick one thing you're forcing through willpower right now.
Score the Structure and Friction around it 1 to 10.
Change the setup so the right move is the default.
Remove or automate one decision in that routine.
Run it for 2 weeks without relying on motivation.
equation_example: Structure 8, Friction 3. 8 ÷ 3 = 2.7. Higher means your setup is doing the heavy lifting. Lower, with friction beating structure, means you're using discipline to fight a bad setup.
question: Write down one habit you're white-knuckling and one change that would make it automatic.
closing_statement: Build the environment. Let it do discipline's job.
caption:
Principle Nº 103: Structure Beats Willpower

If you need willpower to do it every single day, the setup is the problem, not you.

The right structure makes discipline mostly unnecessary.

Your turn: Write down one habit you're white-knuckling and one change that would make it automatic.
